definitions.pair: technology x stage (t,s); headline = the 11 technologies of the reported ES/EO tables
definitions.cell: country x technology x stage (i,t,s) with an index value
definitions.observed_category: category with a category score in the cell (category_weight > 0)
definitions.constant: range across the economies of the pair <= 1e-12
definitions.country_specific_component: non-imputed values take >= 2 distinct values across the economies of the pair
definitions.effective_weight: category_weight of category_contributions, 0 where unobserved; mean over scored headline cells (effective_cells) or over pairs (effective_pairs)
definitions.category_imputed_share: sum over the components of the category of lambda_v * 1[imputed]; mean over cells in which the category is observed
definitions.sovereign: economy with a Correlates of War state-system code in countrycode::codelist (includes Kosovo and Taiwan)
definitions.years: distinct Year_selected > 0 over positively weighted components of the cell; vintage years exclude projection horizons > run_year

hs6_review.electricity_note: excluded (basket review 2026-10): electrical energy: the commodity the grid carries, not an input to building it. Cross-border power trade ($66.6bn, Atlas 2023) ranked net power exporters as grid suppliers. The cell keeps its minerals categories; its trade basket is now the copper and aluminium material inputs (added 2026-10-09)

grid_midstream_telecom_removed.note: excluded (basket review 2026-10): switching and routing apparatus (network switches, routers, modems): telecommunication

excluded (basket review 2026-10): coaxial cable: telecommunications and broadcasting

excluded_components.NIPO Policy Index: excluded from the composite for now (Oct 2026); NIPO tables kept on disk untouched and may return
excluded_components.Dual-use policy score: not a component (Oct 2026): LLM-elicited judgement identical for every country, so it cannot rank countries

policy.eligibility_rule: a country is scored if IEA PAMS is observed for at least one of its cells (over the headline technologies in `techs`); a component it lacks everywhere is left out and policy_basis records what its index rests on (e.g. 'IEA PAMS only'; user decision 9 Oct 2026, both were required before); weights are renormalised over the components present in each cell
